name: Dogpile (Combat)
body:
Prerequisites: Dirty Fighting

Benefit: Whenever you make a melee attack against a prone target, you can forego the normal +4 on your attack roll. If you do and hit, they become sickened for 1 round. Multiple hits stack, increasing the duration of the sicken.
